_source: OSRS Wiki: Dorgesh-Kaan-Keldagrim train system (Another Slice of H.A.M. completed; the player waits in the train, no NPC to talk to; waiting and cutscene together 50 ticks). Everything else is rsprox_transcripts/232/03199.txt, a player riding both ways five times (ticks 2809-5139). Ids are cache gamevals.
_stations: Each station's train: the compartments' tiles (the cache map: 2479-2480 x 5534-5553 at Dorgesh-Kaan, 2443-2444 x 5518-5537 at Keldagrim). Stepping in prints 'The train will leave for <the other city> shortly.'; stepping out, nothing (2921, 3871). The arrival tile is the departure tile turned half round between the two trains: (x, y) -> (4923 - x, 11071 - y) (2479,5538 <-> 2444,5533; 2480,5538 <-> 2443,5533; 2443,5530 -> 2480,5541).
_departTicks: Staying aboard, the next train leaves 36 ticks after the arrival's 'will leave shortly' line (2869 -> 2905, 3769 -> 3805, 3819 -> 3855), 50 ticks from one departure to the next with the 14-tick ride, as the Wiki's 50. Stepping in, the recording waited 46, 41 and 61 ticks (2809, 3714, 5065) with no clock found that sets it; the same 36 is used.
_ride: Ticks from the departure (rsprox 232/03199 2855-2871): 0 'The train takes you to <city>.' and the fade out; 3 into the cutscene room at 2542,5506 (fov_clamp, cutscene_status, minimap off, the side tabs closed); 4 fade in, camera moved to 2546,5512 (height 350, rates 232/232) and looking at 2546,5515 (height 100, rates 44/232), synth 3584; 6 slice_train_driveby on the fade's layer; 10 fade out; 13 at the other station (the teleport); 14 controls and tabs back, the camera reset, fade in and, still aboard, the other train's 'will leave shortly' line (2869, 2919, 3769, 3819), from which its 36 ticks run: 50 from departure to departure.

messages.boarded: The train will leave for {city} shortly.
